name: Sagitake Miyu
source:
The student council president of the academy who is popular particularly due to her looks. A mischievous troublemaker who constantly does things without thinking and then pushes the responsibilites onto [url=/c44220]Yuuma[/url]. She sometimes gains random bouts of spiritual powers.

Miyu has very odd habits, with one of them being that she rarely enters and exits her classrooms normally through doors, instead opting to do so through balconies and windows. She is sexually interested in girls, and always becomes excited when [url=/c44210]Nanami[/url] points her wooden sword at her.
